map.IPv4 地址结构、子网掩码与 CIDR，如何算网络地址/广播地址/可用主机数。: IPv4 address structure, subnet mask and CIDR, and how to compute the network address / broadcast address / number of usable hosts.
map.IPv4 是 32 位地址，常写成 4 段十进制。子网掩码/CIDR（如 /24: IPv4 is a 32-bit address usually written as four decimal segments. The subnet mask or CIDR (such as /24) decides how many leading bits are the network number and leaves the rest as the host number.
map.=IP 与掩码按位与；: = IP AND mask bit by bit;
map.即可看到网络地址、广播地址、可用主机范围与数量。: You will then see the network address, broadcast address, and the usable host range and count.
map.主机位 8 bit 共 256 个，去掉网络地址和广播地址剩 254。: The host field is 8 bits giving 256 addresses; removing the network and broadcast addresses leaves 254.
map.CIDR 和子网掩码如何换算？: How do CIDR and the subnet mask convert?
map./24 即掩码 255.255.255.0；前缀长度就是掩码中 1 的个数。: /24 means mask 255.255.255.0; the prefix length is simply the number of 1s in the mask.
map.IPv6 也能这样算吗？: Can IPv6 be calculated this way too?
map.IPv6 地址空间巨大且划分方式不同，本工具聚焦 IPv4/CIDR。: The IPv6 address space is huge and divided differently; this tool focuses on IPv4/CIDR.
